title: Viral Video Hooks for YouTube Shorts

principles.text: We want to know missing details when something is left unsaid.
Fear of missing out (FOMO) makes viewers want to know cool things.
Surprise viewers by breaking usual flow.
People follow what others find interesting.
Hook must convey one idea, not complex.
Name the outcome, mistake, or surprise.
Viewer should know who it's for right away.
Sharpen the promise: highlight result, mistake, secret, comparison.
Grab attention in the first 1-2 seconds.
Visual, text, verbal should reinforce same message.

formulas.name: Have You Heard About
examples: Have you heard about the world’s loneliest toilet?

formulas.name: They Don't Want You To Know
formulas.template: They don't want you to know this [X] secret.
examples: Apple doesn’t want people to know

formulas.name: You've Never Seen Anything Like This
examples: You’ve never seen headphones like these.

formulas.name: I Never Do This
examples: I never buy silk, here's why.

formulas.name: Best Product Ever
formulas.template: This is the best [X] I’ve ever used.
examples: Most powerful charger I’ve ever used.

formulas.name: Today Years Old
formulas.template: I was 'today years old' when I found [X].

formulas.name: Questions I Get Asked A Lot
formulas.template: Questions I get asked a lot: [X]?
examples: Questions I get asked a lot.

formulas.name: I Asked Google
examples: What's the longest jump in history?

formulas.name: Three Things I Do Before
examples: 3 things I do before every flight.

formulas.name: Try This To
examples: Try this to get more views.

formulas.name: Did You Know That
examples: Did you know this book is poisonous?

verbatim_hooks.text: They Don’t Want You to Know This Secret…
verbatim_hooks.why: Conspiracy, intrigue, us vs them dynamic

verbatim_hooks.text: You’ve Never Seen Anything Like This…
I Never Do THIS, and Here’s Why…
Questions I Get Asked a Lot…

twitch_comp_notes: Text hook must be 3-8 words, burned on-screen.
Text hook should sharpen promise: highlight result, mistake, secret, comparison.
Text hook needs to work with visual (Twitch clip) and verbal (streamer reaction).
Show the payoff, not the setup, in the clip and text hook.
Text hook must be self-sufficient for mute-first viewing.
Text hook should convey one idea only to avoid complexity.
